description: obflowsim is developed by the repository's healthcare simulation team as a configurable SimPy model of obstetric patient flow. The documented pre-release supports stationary Poisson arrivals, repeating weekly scheduled arrivals, selected length-of-stay distributions and serial patient routes. Inputs are YAML scenario settings, patient arrival processes, unit capacities and experiment controls; outputs are patient and unit summaries, stop logs and occupancy-change logs. Coverage is a configured service network, not a particular hospital, and run length, warm-up and replications are selected by the user. Source is free under MIT. A limitation is that blocking-related stay adjustments and realistic discharge timing are explicitly not implemented; proposed next-generation features should not be assumed present on the main branch. The model can support hospital capacity and process simulations. The existing SimPy healthcare DES collection (model-simpy-streamlit-healthcare-des) provides related examples. No patient records or executable model archive was downloaded.
